---
name: projectScope
description: Describe when to use this prompt
---
your task is to create a very simple Microsoft Agent Framework based API agent exposed to Microsoft Teams and using streaming as described here - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/platform/bots/streaming-ux?tabs=csharp#stream-messages-user-experience

You will use azd to create all necessary Azure resources, including Azure Bot Service, Azure Functions, and any other required services. The bot should be able to receive messages from Microsoft Teams, process them using the Microsoft Agent Framework, and respond in a streaming manner as described in the documentation.
